selection_basis: Qualify 56 previously enriched NGC galaxy seasons and restore NGC 1266's scientific uncertainty.
review_scope: Qualify existing seasonal hemispheres without recalculating optimal periods; retain all conditions. For NGC 1266 only, also distinguish observed gas outflows from the proposed minor merger and possible black-hole suppression of star formation in IT/EN/ES.
